summary: Frontend-only static site verified end-to-end. Home page loads without console errors (only benign THREE.js deprecation warnings). Hero 3D canvas renders, headline 'Empowering Voices. Celebrating Culture. Inspiring Change.' is visible on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 4 Adinkra symbols render as SVGs and are clickable. WhatWeDo tabs (tab-stage/tab-video) work. Featured Event shows 'Call for Tickets' button with correct tel:7034755322 (no Stripe/checkout). GetInvolved has involved-call-btn (tel:7034755322) and involved-directions-btn (Google Maps) — no donation tiers, no newsletter. Contact section has phone and address cards with correct testids/hrefs, no form fields anywhere on page. Zero email inputs and zero forbidden network calls to /api/payments, /api/contact, or /api/newsletter.

issues: Central white headline letters slightly overlap the gold cross's vertical bar — still legible but visual competition exists at ~1200-1400px wide viewports. Mobile has scrim that resolves it well.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend directory (server.py) may still contain now-obsolete /api/payments, /api/contact, /api/newsletter endpoints from the previous iteration — since the site is static, main agent may wish to prune these for cleanliness. Not a functional issue (frontend does not call them).
THREE.js emits deprecation warnings (PCFSoftShadowMap, THREE.Clock). Consider updating Hero3D to use non-deprecated APIs for future-proofing.
react/no-unknown-property ESLint warnings from react-three-fiber JSX props are expected and can be suppressed via .eslintrc if noise is a concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a single-page React app (no router). Lenis smooth scroll requires stepped window.scrollTo (in ~400px increments with 150ms sleeps) to trigger framer-motion IntersectionObserver reveals. All interactive elements have data-testid. Verified: hero-3d-canvas, home-page, adinkra-adinkrahene/dwennimmen/gyenyame/oheneaniwa, tab-stage, tab-video, call-tickets-btn, involved-call-btn, involved-directions-btn, contact-phone, contact-address. No backend integration remains from the frontend side.
